description: Land Acquisition - Nampamunuwa, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Beruwala, Beruwala D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including revocation of previous land acquisition orders and divestment of specific land allotments. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, and legal procedures related to land ownership and state acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), the core content is specifically about land matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
